GET /skills/search: Search the skill catalog. Pass the query as the `q` parameter.
GET /skills/{skill_id}/versions/{version: Returns download location, SHA-256 checksum and size for a published skill version.
POST /skills/status: Takes a list of skill IDs and reports whether each is published, unpublished or unknown.
GET /portal/skills: Lists published skills, plus your own submissions that are still pending review.
GET /portal/skills/{skill_id}: Returns a skill and its published versions. Full detail requires a signed-in user.
POST /portal/skills/compile: Validates a SKILL.md bundle. With `publish=true` it also publishes the bundle as a new version.
POST /portal/import/preview: Classifies an external skill or MCP server reference and returns a preview without storing anything.
POST /portal/import/submit: Imports a skill, or requests an MCP server, from an external reference.
GET /installations/mine: Lists your skill installations across all of your devices.
POST /installations: Requests a skill install on one device, or on all of your devices when `device_id` is omitted.
POST /mcp-installations: Requests an MCP server install on one device, or on all of your devices.
POST /plugin-installations: Installs a plugin and the skills and MCP servers it contains. Missing parts are reported in the response warnings.
DELETE /plugin-installations/{installati: Deactivates a plugin installation and the parts installed with it.
GET /admin/users: Lists every user in your organization with device count and active status.
GET /admin/users/activity: Per-user sign-in and device activity, plus invite history.
GET /admin/users/{user_id}/activity: Sign-in and device activity for one user.
POST /admin/users/{user_id}/revoke: Kill switch for one user: blocks their access immediately and removes their installs from every device.
POST /admin/users/{user_id}/restore: Re-enables a revoked user. Installs and devices are not restored; the user sets them up again.
GET /admin/devices: Lists all devices in your organization with their owner and install count.
GET /admin/devices/{device_id}: Returns one device with its installations.
POST /admin/devices/{device_id}/revoke: Kill switch for one device: removes its installs and blocks it from syncing.
GET /admin/installations: Organization-wide installation list, filterable by state, skill and user. Paginated.
GET /admin/audit-log: Lists admin audit log entries, with filters.
GET /admin/audit-log/export: Exports the admin audit log as CSV.
GET /admin/mcp/audit: Lists MCP governance audit entries, with filters.
GET /admin/runner-audit: Lists audit events reported by Scenery on employee devices, newest first.
GET /admin/skills: Paginated list of skills with optional filters.
GET /admin/skills/{skill_id}: Returns one skill with its publisher and versions.
GET /admin/skills/{skill_id}/versions: Lists all versions of a skill, newest first.
POST /admin/skills/{skill_id}/archive: Marks a skill inactive. Existing installs are kept.
POST /admin/skills/{skill_id}/unarchive: Makes an archived skill active again.
POST /admin/skills/{skill_id}/revoke: Kill switch: removes the skill from every device that has it.
POST /admin/skills/{skill_id}/unrevoke: Clears the revocation. Devices that already removed the skill do not get it back; users reinstall.
GET /admin/mcp/servers: Lists the MCP servers in your organization's catalog.
GET /admin/mcp/servers/{server_id}: Returns one MCP server catalog entry.
POST /admin/mcp/servers/{server_id}/revo: Kill switch: removes the server from every device that has it.
POST /admin/mcp/servers/{server_id}/unre: Clears the revocation. Users reinstall the server.
GET /admin/plugins: Lists the plugins in your organization's catalog.
POST /admin/plugins/{slug}/revoke: Kill switch: removes the plugin from every device that has it.
POST /admin/plugins/{slug}/unrevoke: Clears the revocation. Users reinstall the plugin.
